description: This file contains a base class for parsing RQL (Resource Query Language) strings using Akka's parboiled2 parsing library. It defines parsing rules for literals, numbers, strings, and whitespace, serving as the foundation for RQL query parsing.

classes.name: RqlParserBase
classes.description: A parser base class providing common parsing rules for RQL expressions, including literals, strings, numbers, and whitespace.

methods.name: Literal
methods.description: Defines the parser rule for various literal types: float, integer, string, boolean, or null.

methods.name: DoubleLiteral
methods.description: Defines the parser rule for parsing double (floating point) literals.

methods.name: LongLiteral
methods.description: Defines the parser rule for parsing long integer literals.

methods.name: Integer
methods.description: Defines the parser rule for integer values with optional sign.

methods.name: Digits
methods.description: Defines rule for sequences of digits.

methods.name: Frac
methods.description: Defines rule for fractional part of floating point literals.

methods.name: StringLiteral
methods.description: Defines rule for double-quoted string literals.

methods.name: StringSingleQuoteLiteral
methods.description: Defines rule for single-quoted string literals.

methods.name: PropertyLiteral
methods.description: Defines rule for property literals consisting of printable characters.

methods.name: CharactersInQuotes
methods.description: Defines rule for characters inside double quotes, handling escape sequences.

methods.name: CharactersInSingleQuotes
methods.description: Defines rule for characters inside single quotes, handling escape sequences.

methods.name: Characters
methods.description: Defines rule for characters in general, including escaped characters.

methods.name: NormalCharInQuotes
methods.description: Defines rule for normal characters in double-quoted strings.

methods.name: NormalCharInSingleQuotes
methods.description: Defines rule for normal characters in single-quoted strings.

methods.name: NormalChar
methods.description: Defines rule for normal characters outside quotes.

methods.name: EscapedChar
methods.description: Defines rule for parsing escape sequences for double-quoted strings.

methods.name: SingleQuoteEscapedChar
methods.description: Defines rule for parsing escape sequences in single-quoted strings.

methods.name: Unicode
methods.description: Defines rule for parsing unicode escape sequences.

methods.name: WhiteSpace
methods.description: Defines rule for whitespace characters.

methods.name: ws
methods.description: Helper method to parse a specific character followed by whitespace.

methods.name: clearSB
methods.description: Clears the string builder buffer.

methods.name: appendSB
methods.description: Appends the last matched character to the buffer.

methods.name: appendSB
methods.description: Appends a specific character to the buffer.
